name: Velence (Hungary)
description: Three horizontal stripes of yellow, blue and yellow in the ratio 1:5:1, charged towards the hoist with the town arms of Velence: a blue and yellow shield with a bird, a fish and a bunch of grapes, with a scroll inscribed VELENCE.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
